color.note: Dark is the default theme (html data-theme="dark"); light is the toggle. Text greys are the ink colour at reduced alpha, so they sit on any ground.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Near-black in dark, warm paper in light. Theme changes cross-fade it over .35s.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary ink: headings, body copy that must read, the active nav item, certification rules. 17.8:1 on bg (dark), 16.5:1 (light).

tokens.name: text-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text anyone needs to read: job descriptions and dates, company names, project descriptions, contact copy, group labels, CV/Github/LinkedIn, photo country. FLAG: 3.8:1 on bg (dark) and 3.4:1 (light), under 4.5:1 for 12–14px text; fine at 24px+.

tokens.name: text-dimmer
tokens.usage: Only for things that are fine to miss: inactive nav links and the footer. Don't use it for content. FLAG: about 2:1 on bg in both themes.

tokens.name: pill
tokens.usage: Fill for round controls (theme and language toggles) and the employer logo disc. Barely lifts from bg by design (1.2:1); the icon or label inside carries the contrast.

tokens.name: pill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for pill controls, paired with a 1px lift.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The one hue. Focus rings (2px, 3px offset), text selection, and status signals such as the pulsing Pending dot. Use sparingly: one orange thing per view. 7.3:1 on bg (dark), 4.3:1 (light).

styles.name: name
styles.usage: The two-line name block in About. Under 780px: clamp(56px, 16vw, 96px).

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: Hi, I'm a Pega Certified Senior System Architect

styles.name: job-title
styles.usage: Role in a job entry, lowercase. Fluid: clamp(22px, 3vw, 32px).

styles.name: item-title
styles.usage: Project names with the arrow-out icon.

styles.name: company
styles.usage: Employer name above a job title, in text-dim.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pega consulting with a variety of clients in the financial sector.
styles.usage: All paragraph copy: job and project descriptions, contact text. text-dim, max width-prose. Nav links use this size too (inactive text-dimmer, active text at 500).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Dates and city, group labels, links row, photo location, footer, toggle labels.

spacing.note: Values as used in main.css; no formal scale yet (a move to steps of 8 has been proposed). Mobile (≤780px) swaps the 40px gutter for 24px.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Nav link vertical padding; company-to-title gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Nav link stack gap; separator dot spacing in captions; name-line bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between toggle buttons; photo to caption row.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Thumbnail grid gap and padding; date-to-city gap; mobile nav gap; certification label to list.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Links row gap; footer padding.

tokens.name: space-22
tokens.usage: Logo disc to job text.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: About grid gap; mobile page gutter and top bar padding.

tokens.name: space-26
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of each job entry.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Side nav: links to toggle group.

tokens.name: space-36
tokens.usage: Section label to content; desktop top bar padding.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter; side nav right offset.

tokens.name: space-60
tokens.usage: Gap between project columns.

tokens.name: space-70
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of every section.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Focus ring corners.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Reserved for image tiles; not used on the site at the moment.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Everything round: pill toggles, employer logo discs, the status dot.

size.note: Fixed dimensions and measures from main.css.

tokens.name: size-icon
